name: stata-research-guard
description: Provides Stata main rules, a closed command dictionary, help-first selected-command evidence, and selected raw paper context.

interface.shortDescription: Main rules, closed dictionary, command help, and raw paper context.
interface.longDescription: Lets the model inspect a closed 109-command Stata dictionary, choose exact canonical commands, and retrieve only those commands' Stata-rendered official or maintainer help, factual full-manual availability, and compact paper profiles. Retained full manuals are not returned in the current Phase 2. Exact selected paper blocks can still return their original occurrences and optional directly linked raw log or artifact context; a redesigned expanded manual-plus-paper phase remains deferred. Commands outside the dictionary abort, while partial or unavailable help is reported per command without hiding its paper catalog. The plugin does not scan projects, score or rank candidates, promote templates, productize paper audits, grade generated code, or certify a research design.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill and get_stata_command_evidence to read the main rules and command dictionary, choose exact commands, then read their Stata-rendered help and selected paper context.
Treat paper examples and optional raw logs as nonbinding source context; preserve the current project and selected research specification.
Proceed from help when it fully explains the requested action and the code follows directly; report material help gaps and do not treat paper examples as grammar authority.
